name: March
summary: Spring break begins the year's first crowd wave — Texas week fills the two Texas parks, northern spring breaks spread through the month, and the warm parks absorb all of it.

verdict.short: March at these parks: a good window with known trade-offs. Spring break begins the year's first crowd wave.
bestFor: First warm-weather rides of the year

crowds.shape: Spring break begins the year's first crowd wave — Texas week fills the two Texas parks, northern spring breaks spread through the month, and the warm parks absorb all of it.
peakWindows: The two weeks around the Texas and national spring breaks
quietWindows: The first week, before the break calendar mobilizes

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: Spring break staggers by district, which spreads the crowds more than the summer peak — but the Texas parks concentrate their entire state's break into one intense fortnight.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: It is the best month for the Texas parks' weather and the worst for their crowds: pick your priority.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
